summary: Adds a Validate button to the Machine Editor dialog and a library/command-line validator (Machine/models/validate.py) that reports errors, warnings and info for .fcm machine definitions.

pages.reason: Machine/ui/editor/machine_editor.py: button_layout gains a 'Validate' QPushButton calling validate_current_machine, which shows a message box with error/warning counts and detailed findings; Machine/models/validate.py: new CLI 'FreeCADCmd validate.py --pass MACHINES_DIR' and validate_file/validate_machine library API for .fcm files

Machine/ui/editor/machine_editor.py: new 'Validate' button in the editor's button row with tooltip 'Check this machine for problems that would stop it loading or would silently drop settings'; Machine/models/validate.py: validate_file/validate_machine library functions and Severity enum usable from scripts

meta.title: CAM: add a validator for machine (.fcm) definitions
